description: A run of exactly one test file under a config with `verbose: false`, Jest 30.5.2 (T9.7, B21c): `@jest/core`'s runJest leaves verbose off for one file when `globalConfig.verbose === false` (a verbose that is merely unset is not false), so the project of report-single-file prints as the default reporter does: the header, the console block under it, and the totals, with no list of tests. One Jest worker. A black-box run.
